description: This Java class defines the 'CustomerAttributes' entity, which manages a list of 'CustomerOption' objects related to customer attributes in an e-commerce system. It provides getter and setter methods for accessing and modifying the list of customer options.

classes.name: CustomerAttributes
classes.description: Entity class representing customer attribute options, encapsulating a list of CustomerOption objects.

methods.name: getCustomerOptions
methods.description: Retrieves the list of CustomerOption objects associated with customer attributes.

methods.name: setCustomerOptions
methods.description: Sets the list of CustomerOption objects associated with customer attributes.
